name: Yukawa Ryou
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c12295]Chouji[/url]'s and [url=https://vndb.org/c12296]Eika[/url]'s cousin who is currently living with them. She's a very superstitious person. Ryou is also recognized as a school idol like Chouji as she's not only beautiful but also possesses the strength to eliminate most of the delinquents around the school. Thus, other students believe that Ryou and [url=https://vndb.org/c12297]Tane[/url] have a rivalry kind of relationship between them (as in honor student versus a delinquent). Other than that, she's Chouji's classmate and a vice president of the Student Council at their school.

[spoiler]Some time ago during their childhoods, she was engaged to be married to Chouji by [url=https://vndb.org/c66112]her grandfather[/url].[/spoiler]
